articles.title: Snap is hosting a Specs launch event in September.
articles.description:
The event, taking place on September 16th at 7PM ET, will be livestreamed.
Snap announced the design for the augmented reality glasses — and their eye-watering $2,195 price — in June, but it’s unclear if anyone can look cool wearing them. (They seem especially heavy on the ears.)
[Link: See for Yourself: Watch the SPECS Launch on September 16 | https://newsroom.snap.com/specs-launch-date | Snap Inc.]
